S0C1.title: Operation exception – invalid instruction
causes: Branch into non-executable storage: a CALL target or function pointer is wrong/unresolved
Missing STEPLIB or load library: the module was not loaded, code area is zeroes
Corrupted ESD (link-edit error) or wrong load module
look_at: CALL statements in the failing program
STEPLIB/JOBLIB DD in the JCL
link-edit MAP for unresolved externals

S0C4.title: Protection exception – bad memory address
causes: Array subscript or index out of range (beyond OCCURS size)
Null or uninitialised pointer / ADDRESS OF item
CALL USING argument count or order mismatch between caller and called program
Reference to a record area before the file is opened
look_at: OCCURS and subscript values
CALL USING argument lists
pointer SET statements
LINKAGE SECTION items

S0C5.title: Addressing exception – address outside virtual storage
causes: Pointer arithmetic produced an address below 0 or above the region
COMPUTE on a pointer or binary field overflowed
look_at: SET ADDRESS statements
COMPUTE with ADDRESS OF
binary arithmetic that could overflow

S0C6.title: Specification exception – data not aligned
causes: A fullword or doubleword binary field (COMP/BINARY) stored at an odd address
Redefining a field with different alignment requirements
look_at: REDEFINES clauses over COMP items
77-level or 01-level COMP fields that share storage with odd-length items

S0C7.title: Data exception – invalid packed-decimal or zoned-decimal data
causes: A numeric field contains spaces, letters or non-numeric characters
Input record layout does not match the FD (wrong columns or LRECL)
A MOVE from an alphanumeric field to a numeric field without numeric validation
File opened for the wrong record type (e.g. binary vs text)
look_at: Input data fields at the columns the FD defines as numeric
MOVE statements feeding numeric arithmetic
IF ... NUMERIC checks before arithmetic

S0C8.title: Fixed-point overflow exception
causes: COMPUTE or arithmetic result too large for the receiving COMP/BINARY field
Missing ON SIZE ERROR clause on COMPUTE/ADD/MULTIPLY
look_at: COMPUTE/ADD/MULTIPLY statements on COMP fields
whether ON SIZE ERROR is coded

S0C9.title: Fixed-point divide exception – integer division by zero
causes: COMPUTE or DIVIDE with a COMP/BINARY divisor that equals zero
Counter or accumulator not initialised before division
look_at: DIVIDE and COMPUTE / expressions
whether the divisor is checked for zero first

S0CA.title: Decimal overflow exception – packed-decimal result too large
causes: COMPUTE or ADD result exceeds the PIC 9 definition (too many digits)
Missing ON SIZE ERROR clause
look_at: PIC size of the result field vs maximum possible value
ON SIZE ERROR clause

S0CB.title: Decimal divide exception – packed-decimal division by zero
causes: DIVIDE or COMPUTE / with a PACKED-DECIMAL divisor that is zero
Record count or total not yet accumulated when division runs
End-of-file branch skipped, division done even when no records were read
look_at: DIVIDE and COMPUTE / statements
the variable used as divisor and where it gets its value
IF divisor = 0 guard before division

S013.title: Dataset open error – wrong RECFM, LRECL or BLKSIZE
causes: FD record size does not match the dataset's LRECL
RECFM=FB but dataset is RECFM=VB (or vice versa)
BLKSIZE in JCL overrides dataset label and breaks blocking
look_at: FD RECORD CONTAINS / RECORDING MODE
DCB parameters in the DD statement
actual dataset attributes with LISTCAT

S213.title: Dataset open error – dataset not found (dynamic allocation failed)
causes: DD statement names a dataset that does not exist
Dataset was created in an earlier step that did not run (COND check skipped it)
Typo in the DSN= or DSNAME= value
look_at: DSN= in the failing DD
whether the creating step actually ran (check COND CODE)
LISTCAT for the dataset name

S222.title: Job cancelled by operator – CPU time limit (short or dynamic)
causes: Infinite loop: PERFORM UNTIL condition never becomes true
EOF flag on a file never set because AT END logic is missing
Long-running sort or DB2 query without expected indexes
look_at: PERFORM UNTIL loops
AT END handling on READ statements
TIME= in the JCL EXEC statement

S322.title: CPU time limit exceeded
causes: Infinite or very long loop – EOF switch never flipped
READ/WRITE loop not bounded by file content
TIME= parameter in the JOB or EXEC statement too small
look_at: PERFORM UNTIL loops and their termination condition
AT END clause on READ
TIME= in JOB and EXEC statements

S522.title: Job wait time limit exceeded (job sat in a wait state too long)
causes: WTOR (operator reply) with no operator available
DISPLAY UPON CONSOLE waiting for a reply
Locked resource (ENQUEUE/DB2 lock) not released
look_at: DISPLAY UPON CONSOLE / ACCEPT FROM CONSOLE
WAIT TIME= in JOB statement
DB2 lock timeouts (SQLCODE -911)

S722.title: SYSOUT line limit exceeded
causes: A DISPLAY or WRITE SYSOUT loop produced too many lines
LINES= on the DD statement too small for the actual output
look_at: DISPLAY statements inside loops
LINES= on SYSOUT DD statements

S806.title: Module not found – load failed
causes: CALL target program was never compiled or the compile failed
Load module is in a library not in STEPLIB/JOBLIB
Member name in CALL differs from the link-edit member name (case or typo)
look_at: CALL statement spelling vs load module name
STEPLIB/JOBLIB DD concatenation
whether the compile and link-edit steps completed with RC=0

S837.title: Out of real storage – region too small
causes: REGION= in EXEC or JOB is too small for the program's working storage
Many large arrays or tables defined in WORKING-STORAGE
look_at: REGION= value in JOB and EXEC
size of large WORKING-STORAGE tables (OCCURS)

S878.title: Out of virtual storage – GETMAIN failed
causes: Program allocates large amounts of storage dynamically (CICS/DB2 buffers, sort work)
REGION= too small
look_at: REGION= value
DB2 sort work and buffer pool sizes

SA14.title: User or LE abend – STOP RUN issued while in a called program
causes: A called subprogram issued STOP RUN instead of GOBACK
LE condition handler raised a terminal condition (e.g. after CEE3207S)
look_at: subprograms called at the time of the abend
STOP RUN vs GOBACK in subprograms
CEE/IGZ messages just before the abend

S913.title: Security: RACF/ACF2 dataset access denied
causes: The job's user ID does not have READ permission on the dataset
The dataset is protected by a RACF profile the user is not in
look_at: ICH408I message in JESMSGLG
RACF profile for the dataset (ask your security admin)
the user ID the job runs under (USER= in JOB statement)

SB37.title: Out of space – primary and secondary extents exhausted
causes: Dataset SPACE allocation is too small for the volume of data written
A write loop is not terminating (infinite WRITE)
look_at: SPACE= in the DD statement
WRITE loops and their exit condition
whether a prior step should have deleted/emptied the dataset

SD37.title: Out of space – no secondary extent available
causes: Dataset was allocated without secondary space (SPACE=(CYL,(n,0)))
Dataset spans all available extents on the volume
look_at: SPACE=(CYL,(primary,secondary)) in the DD
number of extents already used (LISTCAT)

SE37.title: Out of space – maximum extents reached (16 for non-extended format)
causes: Dataset grew across 16 extents; no more can be added on this volume
Multi-volume not specified and data grew beyond one volume
look_at: SPACE allocation size
whether MXIG or extended-format datasets are needed
whether a DISP=DELETE step should clean up before this step

U0016.title: LE user abend 16 – unhandled condition (CEE default action = ABEND)
causes: A Language Environment condition was signalled and not caught
Common trigger: S0C7 / S0CB raised inside a LE-conforming program
look_at: CEE3207S or CEE3204S message before the abend
LE condition handlers (ON EXCEPTION / USE AFTER ERROR)
the underlying system abend code in the dump

U1020.title: LE user abend 1020 – CICS or IMS pseudo-abend mapped to LE
causes: CICS transaction abended (e.g. ASRA, AICA) and LE mapped it to U1020
IMS pseudo-abend forwarded to LE
look_at: CICS transaction dump for the original abend code
HANDLE ABEND or RESP checking in the CICS COBOL program

U4038.title: LE severe error – run-time termination (often caused by I/O or data error)
causes: File opened without FILE STATUS and a bad status occurred (LE terminates the run)
An IGZ0035S message just before this abend names the file and status code
COBOL STOP RUN after detecting an error and calling CEEMRCE
look_at: IGZ0035S or IGZ0037S messages in SYSOUT
FILE STATUS clause on all SELECT statements
the step that precedes the U4038 in the spool

file_status.02: Duplicate alternate key (VSAM KSDS) – write succeeded but a duplicate alt-key was found
file_status.04: Record length does not match FD – wrong LRECL or the record is shorter/longer than expected
file_status.05: Optional file not present – file does not exist; SELECT OPTIONAL allows this for OPEN INPUT
file_status.07: CLOSE on a file opened in wrong mode, or REWIND on a non-tape file
file_status.10: End of file (AT END) – normal end of sequential read
file_status.14: Sequential read beyond end of relative file
file_status.21: Sequence error on WRITE to an indexed file (key not in ascending order)
file_status.22: Duplicate primary key – tried to WRITE or REWRITE a record with an already existing key
file_status.23: Record not found – READ with a key that does not exist in the file
file_status.24: Disk full (VSAM) – no space for a new record
file_status.30: Permanent I/O error – hardware or DASD error; check SYSLOG for IECnnnI messages
file_status.34: Disk full (sequential) – no more space on the volume
file_status.35: File not present at OPEN – dataset does not exist; check DSN= in the DD
file_status.37: OPEN for WRITE/EXTEND but file is read-only (tape or protected dataset)
file_status.38: File already open or was not closed properly
file_status.39: Attribute conflict – LRECL, RECFM, BLKSIZE or key length in the FD does not match the actual dataset
file_status.41: OPEN on an already open file
file_status.42: CLOSE on a file that is not open
file_status.43: DELETE or REWRITE attempted without a prior successful READ
file_status.44: REWRITE: new record length differs from original record length
file_status.46: Sequential READ but no prior successful START or READ
file_status.47: READ on a file not opened for INPUT or I-O
file_status.48: WRITE on a file not opened for OUTPUT, EXTEND or I-O
file_status.49: DELETE or REWRITE on a file not opened for I-O
file_status.90: VSAM logic error – check IDCAMS LISTCAT for the file
file_status.92: VSAM logic error (not enough virtual storage for VSAM buffers)
file_status.93: VSAM resource not available (file busy or not allocated)
file_status.94: VSAM sequential record not available (concurrent access conflict)
file_status.95: VSAM invalid or incomplete file information
file_status.96: VSAM no DD statement – the DD name in the SELECT is missing from the JCL
file_status.97: VSAM OPEN successful but VERIFY was required (file was not closed properly last time)

sqlcode.100: Row not found (end of cursor or SELECT INTO returned nothing)
sqlcode.-007: Illegal character in SQL statement – often a special character not allowed in SQL
sqlcode.-010: String constant not terminated – missing closing quote
sqlcode.-051: Cursor not open – FETCH before OPEN CURSOR
sqlcode.-084: SQL statement not in a valid context
sqlcode.-101: Statement too long or too complex
sqlcode.-104: Syntax error in SQL – unexpected token near the position shown
sqlcode.-117: Number of values does not match number of columns in INSERT
sqlcode.-180: Invalid date/time value – check the format string and the data
sqlcode.-181: Date/time value not within valid range
sqlcode.-198: INTO clause missing from INSERT or SELECT INTO
sqlcode.-204: Object not found – table, view or alias does not exist; check spelling and qualifier
sqlcode.-206: Column does not exist in the table
sqlcode.-270: Cannot update a column referenced in a GROUP BY or DISTINCT
sqlcode.-305: NULL value returned but host variable has no indicator variable
sqlcode.-310: Host variable contains data that is not numeric where numeric is required
sqlcode.-311: Host variable length is negative or greater than maximum
sqlcode.-313: Number of host variables does not match number of parameter markers
sqlcode.-332: Character conversion error – source and target CCSIDs are incompatible
sqlcode.-404: UPDATE or INSERT value is too long for the column
sqlcode.-407: NULL value not allowed in a NOT NULL column
sqlcode.-408: Value of wrong data type for the column
sqlcode.-532: Referential integrity violation – parent row deleted while child rows exist
sqlcode.-551: Not authorised to perform the operation on the object
sqlcode.-552: Not authorised for the SQL statement
sqlcode.-601: Object already exists – CREATE fails because name is taken
sqlcode.-603: Unique index cannot be created – duplicate keys already exist in the table
sqlcode.-670: Row too long for the page size
sqlcode.-803: Duplicate primary or unique key – INSERT/UPDATE violates uniqueness
sqlcode.-805: DBRM/package not found in plan – run BIND after every compile
sqlcode.-811: SELECT INTO returned more than one row – use a cursor or add a WHERE condition
sqlcode.-818: Timestamp mismatch – DBRM and load module compiled at different times; re-link
sqlcode.-904: Resource unavailable – DB2 object in use or stopped; check with DBA
sqlcode.-911: Rollback due to deadlock or timeout – retry the transaction
sqlcode.-922: Authorization failure (dynamic SQL) – user not authorised at runtime
sqlcode.-927: Language Interface not in the module – program was not precompiled correctly
sqlcode.-10000: Connection to DB2 failed – check SUBSYS= in the JCL and whether DB2 is up

messages.IEF212I: Dataset not found – the DSN= in the DD statement does not exist. Create it or fix the name.
messages.IEF344I: Dataset not available – cannot allocate the dataset (catalogued elsewhere or in use).
messages.IEF210I: Dataset allocated but not on expected volume – check VOL=SER or catalog.
messages.IEF211I: Dataset unallocated – the previous step deleted it, or it was never created.
messages.IEF253I: Duplicate dataset name in the DD concatenation.
messages.IEF217I: DYNAMIC ALLOCATION FAILED – generic catch-all; see the system completion code with it.
messages.IEF272I: Step was not executed – a COND= or IF/THEN test skipped this step. Check why the previous step returned the RC it did.
messages.IEF450I: Step abended – line identifies step name and abend code (system or user).
messages.IEF453I: JCL ERROR – the job did not start. Read the IEFCnnnI messages around it for the specific error.
messages.IEF142I: Step executed – normal completion message with the condition code.
messages.IEFC630I: Invalid DD statement syntax – check parentheses, equals signs and continuation commas.
messages.IEFC663I: Unmatched DD name – a PROC step references a DD that was not passed in the EXEC PROC=.
messages.IEC020I: OPEN failed for a QSAM sequential file; see the reason code after the dash.
messages.IEC026I: CLOSE failed – usually a write error or out-of-space on the dataset.
messages.IEC030I: Block count mismatch at CLOSE – data may be corrupted; check WRITE loops.
messages.IEC070I: Permanent I/O error (SYNADAF) – hardware error or bad tape; retry or restore from backup.
messages.IEC141I: Dataset is not on the volume listed in the catalog – catalog and VTOC are out of sync; contact storage admin.
messages.IGZ0035S: File opened without FILE STATUS and got a non-zero status. Add FILE STATUS to the SELECT or fix the underlying problem (status code is in the message).
messages.IGZ0037S: File I/O error with no FILE STATUS clause. The status code in the message tells you what went wrong.
messages.IGZ0039S: SORT or MERGE failed. Check RC and SYSOUT of the sort step for more detail.
messages.IGZ0200S: Arithmetic overflow – result exceeds the field size. Add ON SIZE ERROR or make the field larger.
messages.IGZ0201S: Divide by zero (decimal). Guard with IF divisor = 0 before the DIVIDE/COMPUTE.
messages.CEE3207S: A hardware exception (usually S0C7 data, S0CB divide) was raised inside a LE program. The statement number is in the CEEDUMP.
messages.CEE3204S: A COBOL run-time error was raised (e.g. subscript out of range). See message text for the specific condition.
messages.CEE5201S: Stack overflow – excessive recursion or very large 01-level items on the stack.
messages.DSNT408I: DB2 SQLCODE –408 in dynamic SQL – data type mismatch; host variable type does not match column.
messages.DSNT501I: DB2 SQLCODE –501 – FETCH attempted when cursor is not open.
messages.IDC3009I: VSAM OPEN failed – status in the message. Usually RC 8, reason 42 = file busy.
messages.IDC3303I: VSAM record not found – key does not exist; check your input key value.
messages.IKJ56500I: TSO command not found – check spelling and CLIST/REXX path.
messages.IKJ56700I: Dynamic allocation error in TSO – see the reason code.
messages.IAT3000: JES2 job class or sysaff problem – job cannot start; check CLASS= and SYSAFF=.
messages.IAT5210: JES2 output limit exceeded (OUTLIM= on a SYSOUT DD) – increase OUTLIM= or fix the WRITE loop.
